tools.description: Search repository text and source files with a regular expression and return file, line, surrounding context, and match counts. This is a static grep-like capability for tracing symbols, hooks, event names, and options without executing code.
tools.label: Static code search
tools.name: code_search

case_sensitive.description: Whether matching is case-sensitive; defaults to true.

context_lines.description: Number of lines of context to include around each match, from 0 to 10.

extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions to include; defaults to py,rst,txt,cfg,ini,html,js,css.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return, from 1 to 200.

path.description: Root directory to search; must be under /testbed and defaults to /testbed.

pattern.description: Regular expression to search for in file contents.

tools.description: Parse Python source files in the repository and report definitions and references for a symbol. Useful for separating definition sites from call sites and tracing callers of backend schema methods without executing code.
tools.label: Python symbol map
tools.name: symbol_map

kind.description: What to return: all, definitions, or references; defaults to all.

max_results.description: Maximum matches per category, from 1 to 500; defaults to 200.

path.description: Root directory to scan; must be under /testbed and defaults to /testbed.

symbol.description: Exact symbol name to look up.
